svg.title: One Cohort, Five Evidence Filters
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-nested-site-conversion-cohorts; chart type: funnel; title: One Cohort, Five Evidence Filters; subtitle: Every surviving site remains a subset of the original 120 parcels.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative mature annual cohort, not observed conversion performance or a 30-day sales forecast. Counts are sites, not MW. Track BESS and AI campus subcohorts separately even when reporting this combined funnel.; caption: Only three of 120 screened sites reach paid transfer or milestone status; rejected and expired sites still consume cash.; stages: label: Mapped candidate parcels; value: 120 parcels entered with distinct asset classifications; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Capture parcel identifiers, ownership, corridor distance, source dates, zoning district, and preliminary hazards. Deduplicate adjoining tracts before assigning one site identifier to a potential transaction.; label: Fatal-flaw screen survivors; value: 48 parcels survive the first desktop screen; numeric value: 48.0; detail: Forty percent of the original cohort survives access, flood, wetland, mineral, and apparent zoning checks. Mapped overlays are screening evidence rather than jurisdictional determinations or final permits.; label: Documented utility-path candidates; value: 18 sites retain an actionable utility pathway; numeric value: 18.0; detail: Thirty-seven and one-half percent of the previous stage receives sufficiently specific utility responses to justify further diligence. Preliminary responses remain explicitly conditional and do not establish guaranteed deliverable capacity.; label: Controlled diligence positions; value: Six sites secure assignable contingent option interests; numeric value: 6.0; detail: One-third of utility-path candidates reaches signed site control. Apply option-fee caps and expiration dates; the illustrative annual loss budget includes three unsuccessful positions costing $16,000 each.; label: Paid assignment or milestone sites; value: Three sites generate realized operator fee events; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Half of controlled positions produces paid events, equal to 2.5 percent of the initial cohort. Multiple distinct earned fee events may occur at one site; never count the same contractual consideration twice.

circle.title: label: Mapped candidate parcels; value: 120 parcels entered with distinct asset classifications; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Capture parcel identifiers, ownership, corridor distance, source dates, zoning district, and preliminary hazards. Deduplicate adjoining tracts before assigning one site identifier to a potential transaction.

label: Fatal-flaw screen survivors; value: 48 parcels survive the first desktop screen; numeric value: 48.0; detail: Forty percent of the original cohort survives access, flood, wetland, mineral, and apparent zoning checks. Mapped overlays are screening evidence rather than jurisdictional determinations or final permits.

label: Documented utility-path candidates; value: 18 sites retain an actionable utility pathway; numeric value: 18.0; detail: Thirty-seven and one-half percent of the previous stage receives sufficiently specific utility responses to justify further diligence. Preliminary responses remain explicitly conditional and do not establish guaranteed deliverable capacity.

label: Controlled diligence positions; value: Six sites secure assignable contingent option interests; numeric value: 6.0; detail: One-third of utility-path candidates reaches signed site control. Apply option-fee caps and expiration dates; the illustrative annual loss budget includes three unsuccessful positions costing $16,000 each.

label: Paid assignment or milestone sites; value: Three sites generate realized operator fee events; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Half of controlled positions produces paid events, equal to 2.5 percent of the initial cohort. Multiple distinct earned fee events may occur at one site; never count the same contractual consideration twice.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative mature annual cohort, not observed conversion performance or a 30-day sales forecast. Counts are sites, not MW. Track BESS and AI campus subcohorts separately even when reporting this combined funnel.
